name: invoiceflow-bola
title: InvoiceFlow — Broken Object Level Authorization
description: An authenticated invoice service exposes GET /api/invoices/{id}. The query is parameterized and the endpoint requires a valid bearer token, but it never checks that the requesting user owns the invoice. Read another tenant's invoice to recover the flag.
note: HackBench-style challenge format (Dockerized target + planted flag). ProofTrace solves this end to end: builds the source->sink graph, forms a BOLA hypothesis, and reproduces the exploit live against this container.
